title: BTC Spot Bar Record Schema
description: Canonical OHLCV bar record for BTC/USD spot from external data providers. BTC is explanatory data only — no execution, no broker connectivity, no trading authorization. BTC data is 24/7 market data and must not inherit equity-session assumptions. Records from different venues or indices must not be silently merged. This schema defines the record shape for BTC spot data used as an explanatory input to Track A (MSTR equity research).

raw_record_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the canonical serialization of governed data fields.

provider_role_id.description: Provider role identifier. e.g. primary_btc_spot, fallback_btc_spot.

instrument_id.description: Canonical instrument identifier. Format: {base_asset}/{quote_asset}@{venue_or_index}.crypto_spot, e.g. BTC/USD@COINGECKO.crypto_spot.

asset_class.description: Asset class. Always 'crypto_spot'. Distinct from 'equity' to enforce track-level isolation.

research_track.description: BTC spot data is exclusively assigned to TRACK_A_MSTR_BTC. It must not be used by TRACK_B_SPY_QQQ.

execution_eligible.description: Must be false. BTC is data-only. No execution. BTC must never enter the equity order or proposal path.

event_timestamp_utc.description: Bar close timestamp in RFC 3339 UTC, ending in 'Z'. For daily bars in 24/7 crypto markets, this is typically 00:00 UTC of the following calendar day.

source_timestamp_utc.description: Provider-asserted timestamp in RFC 3339 UTC, ending in 'Z'. Must be distinct from ingestion_timestamp_utc.

ingestion_timestamp_utc.description: Timestamp in RFC 3339 UTC, ending in 'Z', when this record was received and written. Must be >= source_timestamp_utc.

available_at_utc.description: Timestamp in RFC 3339 UTC, ending in 'Z', at which this record became available for model consumption. Models may use a record only when available_at_utc is not later than the evaluation as-of timestamp.

revision_number.description: Monotonically increasing revision counter. Initial ingestion is revision 1. Later revisions must not rewrite an immutable earlier raw record.

is_final.description: True when this revision is the final, corrected version.

data_quality_state.description: Quality state after quality engine evaluation.

base_asset.description: Base asset. Always 'BTC' for this schema. No other crypto assets are authorized.

quote_asset.description: Quote asset. Always 'USD'. BTC/USD pair only.

venue_or_index.description: Venue or index identity. Must remain explicit. e.g. COINGECKO, COINDESK_BPI, MESSARI. Records from different venues or indices must not be silently merged.

bar_interval.description: Bar interval. Daily bars ('1day') are the primary resolution.

open.description: Opening price for the bar period.

high.description: Highest price during the bar period.

low.description: Lowest price during the bar period.

close.description: Closing price for the bar period.

volume_base.description: Traded volume in base asset (BTC). Must never be negative.

volume_quote.description: Notional volume in quote asset (USD). Required when the provider supplies it.

trade_count.description: Number of trades during the bar period. Required when the provider supplies it.

market_state.description: Market state during this bar period. BTC is 24/7 — 'WEEKEND' and 'HOLIDAY' denote reduced-liquidity periods, not market closure. Must not inherit equity-session assumptions.

aggregation_method.description: Method used to aggregate trades into this bar. Records from different venues or indices may use different aggregation methods — this must remain observable.

prices_positive.rule: open > 0 AND high > 0 AND low > 0 AND close > 0

volumes_non_negative.rule: volume_base >= 0 AND (volume_quote IS NULL OR volume_quote >= 0)

timestamps_rfc3339_utc_z.rule: All timestamp fields must end with 'Z'. No offset notation permitted.

no_timestamp_substitution.rule: source_timestamp_utc, event_timestamp_utc, ingestion_timestamp_utc, and available_at_utc must remain distinct fields with documented meanings. No silent substitution.

base_asset_is_btc.description: Only BTC is authorized. No other crypto assets.

venue_explicit.rule: venue_or_index IS NOT NULL AND venue_or_index IS NOT EMPTY
venue_explicit.description: Venue or index identity must remain explicit.

no_silent_venue_merge.rule: Records from different venue_or_index values must not be silently merged into a single dataset. Cross-venue comparison requires explicit documentation.

fallback_data_marked.rule: IF provider_role_id indicates a fallback provider THEN the record must be tagged as fallback. Fallback use must never be invisible.

provider_disagreement_observable.rule: Provider or venue disagreement in close price > 1% must remain observable. Records from different providers/venues must carry distinct provider_role_id and venue_or_index.

missing_btc_no_trade_track_a.rule: IF required BTC data is missing, stale, or REJECTED for the evaluation window THEN produce NO_TRADE for TRACK_A_MSTR_BTC

no_crypto_trading_fields.rule: No wallet addresses, exchange accounts, trading pairs beyond BTC/USD, order types, position sizes, leverage, margin, or execution instructions.

no_equity_session_inheritance.rule: BTC bar records must not inherit equity-session assumptions. market_state must use the crypto-specific enum values (ACTIVE, WEEKEND, HOLIDAY, UNKNOWN), not equity session types.

track_b_spy_qqq.reason: Track B is equity-only (SPY/QQQ). BTC data is exclusive to TRACK_A_MSTR_BTC.
